# ln-symlink

## Simple string guard
- Sees: `src`, `link`, `-s`; order and roles unclear.
- Runmark separates the read source from the written link name.

## RunmarkFacts incremental
- `read: logical://workspace/src`, `write: logical://workspace/link`.

## Notes
- Handwritten baseline for Spike differentiation.
- Not a verified claim about any specific third-party Guardrail version.
